text.printed: When Revealed: Exhaust each Hacked upgrade under your control. If you cannot, search the encounter deck and discard pile for the Rogue Asset side scheme and put it into play. If Rogue Asset is already in play, stun your identity. [star] Boost: Stun your identity.
